# Citation Act

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CitationAct>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/citations`](../../slices/citations.md)

A reified citation: a citing entity cites a cited entity with a typed intent, optionally via a selector (a pinpoint into the cited work), carrying provenance, confidence, and standpoint. Replaces the old hasSource/citesSource: genealogical evidence is a [`CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md) with intent [`intentCitesAsDataSource`](../individuals/gmeow-intentCitesAsDataSource.md) toward a creative work, via a selector.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
